examples.scenario: Attackers compromised a popular open-source JavaScript library's NPM package by injecting malicious code into a dependency update, which propagated through the supply chain to thousands of downstream projects. The malicious code created a backdoor that exfiltrated environment variables and system info to a C2 server after package installation and execution.

examples.detection_method: Automated dependency scanning with SBOM comparison detects unknown package versions and integrity mismatches. Code signing verification failure logs alert when verifying package authenticity. Network monitoring detects anomalous HTTPS POST requests from build or CI environments to suspicious external domains. Runtime behavior monitoring flags unexpected environment variable exfiltration attempts post-update.
